title: 엽연초생산협동조합법시행령 / queue:ADDENDUM:14438:19941223:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 14438, December 23, 1994>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.
Article 5 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (37) Omitted.
(38) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Leaf Tobacco Production Cooperatives Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 4 (1) and (2), Article 6, Article 7 (1) and (2), Articles 10 and 11, "Minister of Finance" shall each be replaced with "Minister of Finance and Economy."
(39) through (327) Omitted.
